description: This file contains controller functions for handling account-related API requests in a Strapi-based application, specifically for retrieving all user accounts and a single account.

methods.name: getMyAccounts
methods.description: Fetches all accounts owned by the current user, returning an error if none are found.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Fetches a single account by ID for the current user, returning an error if not found.
